get.summary: Get a specific time slice definition
get.description:
Get a specific time slice definition for a property. A time slice definition specifies the pattern for recurring time slots. The time slots define when reservations in the property can start or end. It is used in the rate plans when managing prices for renting out the units.
You must have at least one of these scopes: 'settings.read, setup.read, setup.manage'.

parameters.name: propertyId
parameters.description: The id of the property.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the time slice definition.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: List of all embedded resources that should be expanded in the response. Possible values are: actions. All other values will be silently ignored.

invoiceNumberPattern.description:
Pattern to generate the invoice number.
Consists of three parts: custom prefix (optional),
date template (optional),
and number template (required).
use '0' for numbers;
'd' or 'dd' for days;
'M' or 'MM' for months;
'yy' or 'yyyy' for years.
To set a custom prefix, enclose it in quotation marks (").
Allowed symbols in the prefix: digits, uppercase letters, .,_,-.
Example: pattern "MUC-"yyyy0000 will produce invoice numbers like MUC-20190001.

advanceInvoiceNumberPattern.description:
Pattern to generate the advance invoice number.
Consists of three parts: custom prefix (optional),
date template (optional),
and number template (required).
use '0' for numbers;
'd' or 'dd' for days;
'M' or 'MM' for months;
'yy' or 'yyyy' for years.
To set a custom prefix, enclose it in quotation marks (").
Allowed symbols in the prefix: digits, uppercase letters, .,_,-.
Example: pattern "MUC-"yyyy0000 will produce invoice numbers like MUC-20190001.
